note: A metric becomes Approved only when the business owner signs every decision it depends on. Evidence below was read from MedcareDW_Dev on 2026-11-05 (aggregate checks only). Evidence is not proof: the owner confirms against the source billing system.

decisions.title: Which columns are the real payment amounts
decisions.question: InsurancePayments + PatientPayments, or InsuranceAmountPaid + PatientAmountPaid?
decisions.evidence: Pair A totals 362.1M, pair B totals 53.8M over the same rows. Pair B matches Amount_Paid on every row. On the sampled row, InsurancePayments equals Charge_Amount (717.00) and InsuranceAmountPaid holds 79.30. 370,392 rows have InsuranceAmountPaid = 0 but InsurancePayments > 0. Total charges on these rows are 605.9M.
decisions.recommendation: Pair B, if the owner confirms with a known claim in the billing system that 79.30 was the amount received.

decisions.title: Payment date basis
decisions.question: Report payments by posting date or deposit date?
decisions.evidence: Posting_Date is never empty (2024-03-05 to 2026-06-05). Deposit_Date is empty on 588,569 rows and uses 1900-01-01 as a placeholder.

decisions.title: Denial versus rejection
decisions.question: Which status values count as a denial, and which as a rejection?
decisions.evidence: FactPayerRejectionReason holds only Accepted (278,572 claims) and Rejected (15,876 claims). 7,473 claims have both. Accepted means receipt acknowledged, not paid. The table has no remittance denial codes.
options: Rejected = rejection; denials need a remittance source
decisions.recommendation: Call Rejected a rejection. Measure true denials only after a remittance (835) source is loaded.

decisions.title: Days to bill: start and end events
decisions.question: Days from date of service to which event?
decisions.evidence: FactDaysToBill has 0 rows. FactGlobalKPIClaimSubmissionsHistory has 1,998,693 rows. First submission joined to date of service covers 494,075 claims, average 29.5 days, 1 negative gap. 213,194 claims in FactClaimCount have no submission history. DOE minus DOS averages 124.8 days, so DOE does not look like a billing date.
options: DOS to first submission (from submission history)
Wait for FactDaysToBill to be loaded
decisions.recommendation: DOS to first submission from submission history, with the 213k uncovered claims shown as a coverage figure.

decisions.title: Practice_Code uniqueness
decisions.question: Is Practice_Code unique across all source servers?
decisions.evidence: In MedcareDW_Dev there are 3 practice codes and no claim number appears under more than one. Production and other source servers are unchecked.
options: Unique only with a source-server key
decisions.recommendation: Confirm with the data team before any cross-practice report goes beyond these three practices.

decisions.title: Duplicate claim lines in FactClaimCount
decisions.question: How are duplicate claim lines handled when counting lines?
decisions.evidence: 888 extra copies among 923,035 rows (same claim, sequence and procedure) for the three practices. Claim counts use distinct claims and are unaffected.
options: Count distinct claim, sequence and procedure

decisions.title: Patient balance source
decisions.question: Where is patient-level billing data loaded?
decisions.evidence: FactCPT_KPI has 0 rows in MedcareDW_Dev, so the patient billing balance always returns no lines.
decisions.recommendation: Point the view at whichever source holds populated charge lines.

decisions.title: Business owner
decisions.question: Who signs metric definitions?
decisions.evidence: The catalogue says 'RCM business owner (to be named)'.
decisions.recommendation: Name one person and one backup.
